name: Miyama Yukino
source: Yukino is the caretaker of the apartment. She is also [url=https://vndb.org/c45169]Aihara Ruri[/url] older cousin. Her husband is usually away on business trips. Its shown that she is in fact a horrible driver to the point that the other residents are scared to get in the car with her.
